item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 07/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will continue to bring thundery showers to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea. The trough of low pressure is expected to depart from the region gradually on Sunday. Showers will lessen over the coast of Guangdong. An anticyclone aloft will bring brighter and hot weather to southern China early to midweek next week. With a southwesterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week, showers will increase with thunderstorms over the region.
